detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Deploy automated behavioral analysis and policy enforcement at the repository firewall level to identify and quarantine suspicious or malicious components before they enter the software development lifecycle. Monitor for abnormal component behaviors, such as unexpected network activity, privilege escalation, or attempts to evade compliance policies. Use AI-driven tools to flag and quarantine components for human review, and block confirmed malicious packages from entering the supply chain.
